slides.headline: Six people who leave fake Trustpilot reviews
The competitor.
slides.body: Vague, angry, and suspiciously keen to mention an alternative.

slides.headline: The affiliate.
slides.body: Earns commission on a rival, so your bad score is their good month.

slides.headline: The ex-employee.
slides.body: Knows how things run inside, describes no order.

slides.headline: The refund chaser.
slides.body: Uses a review as leverage after a disputed chargeback.

slides.headline: The extortionist.
slides.body: Posts a wave of 1-stars, then offers to stop for a fee. Never pay. Screenshot everything.

slides.headline: The wrong-brand reviewer.
slides.body: Real problem, similar name, different company.

slides.headline: Send us the link. We'll tell you if it may have a case.
slides.sub: You only pay once it's gone.
